subject: Cannot archive or delete application where Status = "Purged"

messages.author: 5666582f0c2e3225
messages.subject: Cannot archive or delete application where Status = "Purged"
parts:
Hi all,

The ShinyApp I published yesterday to Shinyapps.io went into "Sleeping" state the next day. Since I had a newer version, I tried to archive and delete the old one. There was an error during archive and deletion, and now the app has a status "Purged", and trying to archive it again returns the error "73946: Invalid Status Purged".

Any pointers what's going on here? 

Cheers,
Max

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Cannot archive or delete application where Status = "Purged"
parts:
Max,

If the application has been purged, you should be able to just delete it, by precessing the delete button.

-Andy

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Cannot archive or delete application where Status = "Purged"
parts:
Max,

I should also mention you do not need to archive a sleeping application to update it. Simply deploy the updated version of the application and the old version will be overwritten. You should only archive an application if you want to prevent it from being used (for example: if you are in the free tier and have 5 distinct applications, you must archive one in order to be able to deploy a 6th one).

-Andy
